correctness.rationale: Exact normalized rank codes are independent by a bijection; computed p_i and j_i give exact D variance. Cross-covariance follows by differentiating known exact mean. Uniform Riemann-sum limits yield Sigma; conditional three-rank variation proves it positive definite; one-dependence with separated blocks gives a rigorous multivariate Lindeberg limit. The packaged 318-test rational checker independently corroborates finite formulas and large-n asymptotics.

value.rationale: Linear record bias produces order-n records instead of logarithmically many, making the correlation between sorting-relevant descent and record statistics an unaddressed natural fluctuation question. The explicit nondegenerate joint Gaussian covariance, including strict negative limiting correlation at every lambda>0, quantifies simultaneous errors in record- and run-based observables and distinguishes the linear regime from prior fixed-parameter asymptotics.
